title: Whole numbers
subtitle: Explore the idea with a visual model.
learning_objective: Use whole numbers confidently as a foundation for fraction thinking.

sections.heading: Make sense of it
sections.body: Whole numbers count complete units. A number line shows their order and the equal distance between neighboring numbers.

sections.heading: See it on a number line
sections.caption: The marked point helps connect position and value.

sections.problem: Start at 2 and move 3 equal steps to the right.
sections.reasoning: Each step keeps the meaning of the whole and its equal parts clear.

sections.heading: Watch for this
sections.body: Count the jumps, not the marks you touch.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.prompt: Which whole number is halfway between 2 and 6?
sections.hint: Use the visual and the worked steps above before choosing.
